usedFor: MSG91 holds the voice calls, and Kylas CRM receives the caller through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new voice call is made or received” in MSG91, then “Create or Update Lead” in Kylas CRM
bestTemplate.why: The action updates or skips on a duplicate phone or email, so repeat callers do not create copies.

watchOut: “Delete Template” in MSG91 removes a template permanently, so keep it away from lead events like “New Lead Created”.
